demo.title: ChatBot · Streaming Chat Assistant
demo.desc: A reusable "streaming chat + card rendering" capability borrowed from the cloud document library: internal identifiers and business coupling removed, rewritten for this project's stack (React 19 / antd 5 / ECharts 6 / Sass) as an injectable-backend, standalone module.
demo.recommendTable: Show the latest monitoring data in a table
demo.recommendChart: Draw a line chart of the temperature trend
demo.recommendTask: List a task list with batch export
demo.mockTitle: Currently using the built-in mock backend
demo.mockDesc: Experience the full pipeline without a backend: status frames → content frames → stop frame, four card types, history sessions and like/dislike. Inject a real API through the api prop when ready.
demo.capsStream: Streaming answers + status bar (tool call progress)
demo.capsCards: Four card types: list / table / line chart / task table
demo.capsCsv: Export tables as CSV; fields with time can switch to chart view (multiple numeric columns become multiple series)
demo.capsBatch: Task table checkbox batch packaging export (polling)
demo.capsHistory: History sessions: list / detail read-back / delete / clear
demo.capsFeedback: Like/dislike feedback, copy, regenerate, stop generation
demo.capsStick: Smart stick-to-bottom: not yanked back while scrolling up, auto-follow at the bottom
demo.capsRender: Render optimization: during streaming only the bubble being generated is redrawn
demo.protocolTitle: Stream protocol highlights (abstracted into pure functions)

share.pageDesc: A reusable "conversation sharing landing page" from the cloud document library: user A picks a few rounds to generate a share, user B (possibly not logged in) opens the link for read-only browsing and can "continue asking" to jump back to the main chat. The component sends no messages and streams nothing; it only does "fetch data → read-only render → provide a continue entry".
share.linkAlertDesc: The share page is an independent route that opens without login. Clicking "Generate a new share" runs one POST /aigc/share, then immediately reads back with the new ID, demonstrating the full loop.
share.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the link manually
share.viewSubtitle: The content below was excerpted from a conversation by the sharer, read-only
share.emptyText: The shared content is empty or has been withdrawn
share.retryHint: Please try again later, or check whether the link is complete
